issues.detail: The Hebrew begins with 'וְאַתָּה' ('And You'), addressing God directly in the second person ('You will hear...'). The Vietnamese rendering 'Đức Giê-hô-va sẽ nghe' ('Jehovah will hear') changes the direct address to a third-person reference, omitting the explicit 'You' and altering the person of the verb from second to third person.
